title: Excellent location and friendly staff
text: I stayed at the hotel Sept. 27-Oct 3, had a lovely room from Michael at the front desk.  Excellent breakfast buffet, wide rage of choice.
author: 805lawrences

title: Mountjuic with beautiful city scenes
text: Our guide, Jonathan, is native of Barcelona so was very knowledgeable about history of the city and historic sites.  Enjoyed  cable car ride to top of Montjuic.  At mountain top, views of the city and sea were magnificent as was touring the fortress and  learning of its use through the years. Olympic village was interesting and there are awesome scenes from in front of the art museum.  So peaceful and beautiful while enjoying a beverage and snack. Jonathan was great tour guide and we highly recommend the tour.
author: CACruzer

title: Our guide was so...
text: Our guide was so knowledgeable and kind. She explained so much to us and made the past come to life!!
author: Surender_R

title: Great way to see the city!
text: The tour was a great way to see the main venues in Barcelona!  Thank you for an informative tour and telling the kids stories that kept them engaged!
author: Valerie_R

title: Thanks Alex!
text: I highly recommend this tour with Alex. My husband and I, both in our 70s, had been to Barcelona before and now wanted to concentrate on specific sites. In particular, we wanted to see Montjuic more thoroughly than from a HOHO bus as we had done previously. This private tour conducted by Alex did just that. He was punctual about meeting us at our hotel. We had the experience of riding on the bus, subway, and the cable car. title: Nice day out!
text: Gaby was a great tour guide who shared information and details about the areas we visited.  Her knowledge and enthusiasm made the tour very enjoyable.
author: Debi_K

title: Wonderful tour with Marta!
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Marta! We got to see and visit so many spots and learned a lot about Montjuic and Barcelona history. Loved getting to ride on the cable car too!
author: jazzastro

title: Montjuic Private Tour
text: Our tour guide was amazing, he came to pick my mum and I up from the hotel and we took the metro to Montjuic Mountain! We chose the 10:00 start time which was a good idea as we managed to get to Teleferic de Montjuic before most people and got to enjoy panoramic views of Barcelona! He was so knowledgeable and answered all our questions well! We then went to the Olympic Park which was within walking distance, and walked through the park to go to Plaza España!
author: Lakshmi S

title: So glad we chose this tour!
text: Our guide met us at our hotel in Barcelona & we rode with her on the subway to Montjuic & then via bus to the Olympic Park and on to the museum. It was a fabulous day. She spoke English well & did a pretty good job with the history & culture of the things we visited. (She's still learning the detailed history but she did a terrific job.) She had a fun personality & gave us a nice tour.
author: robynm682
